messages.subject: Survey Methodology and Item Response Theory - Livestream Seminars
parts:
Hi everyone

Instats is offering two new 2-day seminars on Survey Methodology and Item Response Theory:

The first 2-day seminar Item Response Theory in R and IRTPRO, running Nov 20 - 21, provides a comprehensive introduction to Item Response Theory (IRT), covering fundamental concepts, model specification, parameter estimation, and practical applications using R and IRTPRO. Participants will gain hands-on experience and theoretical knowledge to enhance the quality and precision of their research, including how to conduct IRT modeling and interpret the results for academic research and applied applications.

The second 2-day seminar Introduction to Survey Methodology, running Nov 28 - 29, addresses both theoretical and practical facets of survey methodology, ensuring participants not only understand the principles but also see how these are applied in the real world, making complex concepts accessible and immediately applicable to participants’ ongoing and future research projects. After the workshop, participants will be better prepared to design surveys that yield high-quality, actionable data, while mitigating common pitfalls in survey research and enhancing the overall validity and reliability of their findings.

Sign up today to secure your spots in these unique seminars, and please feel free to tell your friends and colleagues.


Best wishes

Michael Zyphur
Director
